synthesis.body: loop-cohort schedule finds tasks with the pattern '## T<n>' or '### T<n>' and stops with 'no tasks found' on anything else. A plan whose tasks read '### Task 1 - Title' passes every human review and every lint, then fails at schedule time - after approve-plan has already pinned the plan hash, so the fix requires the documented cohort recovery (reset, init, approve-plan, schedule) rather than a simple edit. approve-plan itself does not parse tasks on a fresh run, so nothing rejects the plan while the fix is still cheap. Write task headings as '### T<n>: Title' from the first draft, and check the heading pattern against the shipped precedent in an existing plan before the G-plan sequence rather than after it. The general rule: when a tool consumes a document, the document's structure is an interface with a parser on the other side, so confirm the parser's shape before an irreversible pinning step consumes it.

title: loop-cohort schedule parses task headings by a fixed pattern, and it runs after approve-plan pins the plan
